queries.name: invoice-list
queries.sql:
WITH invoice_facts AS (
  SELECT i0.*, COALESCE(lines.item_count,0)::bigint AS item_count,
    COALESCE(credits.total,0) AS credit_note_total_vnd,
    i0.grand_total_vnd-COALESCE(credits.total,0) AS net_vnd,
    COALESCE(receipts.total,0) AS received_vnd,COALESCE(refunded.total,0) AS refunded_vnd,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(refunded.total,0)>0 AND refunded.total>=COALESCE(receipts.total,0) THEN 'refunded'
         WHEN COALESCE(refunded.total,0)>0 THEN 'partially_refunded'
         WHEN i0.grand_total_vnd=0 OR COALESCE(receipts.total,0)>=i0.grand_total_vnd THEN 'paid'
         WHEN COALESCE(receipts.total,0)>0 THEN 'partially_paid' ELSE 'unpaid' END AS payment_status
  FROM invoices i0
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(quantity) AS item_count FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_id=i0.id AND line_type='product') lines ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(total_vnd) AS total FROM credit_notes WHERE invoice_id=i0.id AND status='issued') credits ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(amount_vnd) AS total FROM payment_receipts WHERE order_id=i0.order_id) receipts ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(amount_vnd) AS total FROM refunds WHERE order_id=i0.order_id AND status='completed') refunded ON TRUE
) SELECT i.id AS "Id",i.invoice_no AS "InvoiceNo",i.order_id AS "OrderId",i.issued_at AS "IssuedAt",
COALESCE(i.customer_snapshot->>'name',i.customer_snapshot->>'displayName',i.customer_snapshot->>'display_name','Khách hàng') AS "CustomerName",
COALESCE(i.staff_snapshot->>'name',i.staff_snapshot->>'displayName',i.responsible_staff_id,'Chưa phân công') AS "StaffName",
i.responsible_staff_id AS "ResponsibleStaffId",i.item_count AS "ItemCount",
i.subtotal_vnd::text AS "SubtotalVnd",i.discount_total_vnd::text AS "DiscountTotalVnd",i.grand_total_vnd::text AS "GrandTotalVnd",
i.credit_note_total_vnd::text AS "CreditNoteTotalVnd",i.net_vnd::text AS "NetVnd",i.payment_status AS "PaymentStatus" FROM invoice_facts i WHERE (TRUE) AND (i.lifecycle=@p0) AND (i.issued_at>=@p1) AND (i.issued_at<@p2) ORDER BY i.issued_at DESC NULLS LAST, i.id DESC LIMIT @p3 OFFSET @p4

Plans.Filter: ((issued_at >= '2023-12-31 17:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (issued_at < '2026-12-31 17:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (lifecycle = 'issued'::text))

queries.name: report-period
queries.sql:
WITH invoice_facts AS (
  SELECT i0.*, COALESCE(lines.item_count,0)::bigint AS item_count,
    COALESCE(credits.total,0) AS credit_note_total_vnd,
    i0.grand_total_vnd-COALESCE(credits.total,0) AS net_vnd,
    COALESCE(receipts.total,0) AS received_vnd,COALESCE(refunded.total,0) AS refunded_vnd,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(refunded.total,0)>0 AND refunded.total>=COALESCE(receipts.total,0) THEN 'refunded'
         WHEN COALESCE(refunded.total,0)>0 THEN 'partially_refunded'
         WHEN i0.grand_total_vnd=0 OR COALESCE(receipts.total,0)>=i0.grand_total_vnd THEN 'paid'
         WHEN COALESCE(receipts.total,0)>0 THEN 'partially_paid' ELSE 'unpaid' END AS payment_status
  FROM invoices i0
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(quantity) AS item_count FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_id=i0.id AND line_type='product') lines ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(total_vnd) AS total FROM credit_notes WHERE invoice_id=i0.id AND status='issued') credits ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(amount_vnd) AS total FROM payment_receipts WHERE order_id=i0.order_id) receipts ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(amount_vnd) AS total FROM refunds WHERE order_id=i0.order_id AND status='completed') refunded ON TRUE
),filtered AS (SELECT i.* FROM invoice_facts i WHERE (TRUE) AND (i.lifecycle=@p0)),events(invoice_id,event_at,dim_id,dim_name,amount,quantity,tender,kind) AS (SELECT i.id AS invoice_id,i.issued_at AS event_at,''::text AS dim_id,'Tất cả hóa đơn'::text AS dim_name,i.grand_total_vnd::bigint AS amount,0::bigint AS quantity,NULL::text AS tender,'issued'::text AS kind FROM filtered i UNION ALL SELECT i.id,c.issued_at,''::text,'Tất cả hóa đơn'::text,c.total_vnd::bigint,0::bigint,NULL::text,'adjustments'::text FROM filtered i JOIN credit_notes c ON c.invoice_id=i.id AND c.status='issued'),window_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE event_at>=@p1 AND event_at<@p2),periods AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month',@p1::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'),date_trunc('month',(@p2::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')-interval '1 microsecond'),interval '1 month') AS period
),dimensions AS (SELECT ''::text AS dim_id,'Tất cả hóa đơn'::text AS dim_name),facts AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month',event_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AS period,dim_id,count(DISTINCT invoice_id) AS invoice_count,
    sum(CASE WHEN kind='adjustments' THEN -quantity ELSE quantity END) AS quantity,sum(CASE WHEN kind='adjustments' THEN -amount ELSE amount END) AS total,COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER(WHERE tender='cash_demo'),0) AS cash_total,
    COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER(WHERE tender='store_credit'),0) AS credit_total FROM window_events GROUP BY 1,2
) SELECT to_char(p.period,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Period",d.dim_id AS "DimensionId",d.dim_name AS "DimensionName",COALESCE(f.invoice_count,0)::bigint AS "InvoiceCount",
    COALESCE(f.quantity,0)::bigint AS "Quantity",COALESCE(f.total,0)::text AS "TotalVnd",COALESCE(f.cash_total,0)::text AS "CashDemoVnd",COALESCE(f.credit_total,0)::text AS "StoreCreditVnd"
  FROM periods p CROSS JOIN dimensions d LEFT JOIN facts f ON f.period=p.period AND f.dim_id=d.dim_id ORDER BY p.period,d.dim_id

Plan.Merge Cond: ((generate_series('2024-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone, '2026-12-01 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone, '1 mon'::interval)) = (date_trunc('month'::text, (i.issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text))))

((issued_at >= '2023-12-31 17:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (issued_at < '2026-12-31 17:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (status = 'issued'::text))
